advancedDesc: Details you rarely change — the defaults are best practice

accurate.title: Most accurate text
accurate.desc: Finest segmentation and the most complete punctuation; keeps each sentence as faithfully as possible. May occasionally add a stray line over silence/background noise.
accurate.scene: Best for lectures, interviews, talking-head videos where complete text matters most

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.desc: Complete yet clean text with a stable timeline; stray lines over silence are basically gone — a safe choice for most videos.
balanced.scene: Best for most videos; pick this if unsure

clean.title: Cleanest & most stable
clean.desc: Suppresses repeats and hallucinated lines most aggressively with the most restrained text; may drop some unclear speech.
clean.scene: Best for long videos or material with music / applause / long silence

custom.title: Custom
custom.desc: Manually tune context length, VAD, repetition reduction and other low-level parameters.
custom.sherpaNote: For the current engine (FunASR / Qwen / FireRed / Parakeet), VAD is always on and there is no context-length / repetition concept. To fine-tune VAD sensitivity, use the Settings page.

compare.caption: Roughly how the same speech (with a short silence at the end) appears at each level:
compare.accurate: Today, let's go over this new feature. Thanks for watching.
compare.balanced: Today let's go over this new feature.
compare.clean: Today let's go over this new feature

vad.label: Voice activity detection (VAD)
vad.on: Faster and steadier: the built-in whisper engine only transcribes inside detected speech, skipping silence/background noise and greatly reducing repeated or hallucinated lines there; lines are aligned token-by-token to the speech segments, so the timeline hugs the speech and stays stable.
vad.off: Most complete text: the built-in whisper engine segments more finely with fuller punctuation (recommended for short/medium files and Chinese); stray lines over silence are curbed by an energy fallback; other engines such as faster-whisper may still produce repeated or hallucinated lines over silence/music.
vad.hint: Turn off for the most complete text and finest segmentation; keep on for the steadiest timeline and fewest stray lines over silence. This is a global setting and affects all tasks.

reduceRepetition.label: Reduce repetition / hallucinated lines
reduceRepetition.on: On: drops previous-text conditioning and suppresses repeats, greatly reducing looped lines over silence/repetition; coherence on clean speech may drop slightly.
reduceRepetition.off: Off: engine defaults (keeps cross-segment coherence); long videos or silence may produce repeated or hallucinated lines.
reduceRepetition.hint: Turn on when subtitles loop or repeat heavily. Global setting; applies to both faster-whisper and whisper.cpp.

fasterWhisperAdvanced.title: Advanced decoding parameters
fasterWhisperAdvanced.summary: Optional; leave blank to use engine defaults
fasterWhisperAdvanced.description: Applies only to the current faster-whisper task. Values are type- and range-checked before dispatch. Blank fields send no overrides and preserve the engine's default strategy.
fasterWhisperAdvanced.runtimeNote: Requires the latest faster-whisper runtime with advanced-parameter forwarding. Older runtimes may ignore some settings; check for updates in Resources → Engines.
fasterWhisperAdvanced.integerRangeError: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}

beam_size.label: Beam size
beam_size.hint: Whole number from 1–20. Higher values can improve decoding stability at the cost of more computation and time.

best_of.label: Best of
best_of.hint: Whole number from 1–20. Keeps more candidates when sampling above zero temperature; higher values cost more computation.

temperature.label: Sampling temperature
temperature.hint: Range 0–1. Higher is more random; a single value replaces the engine's default multi-temperature fallback sequence.

compression_ratio_threshold.label: Compression ratio threshold
compression_ratio_threshold.hint: Range 0–10. Decoding falls back when text compression exceeds this value; low values may cause more retries.

log_prob_threshold.label: Average log-probability threshold
log_prob_threshold.hint: Range -5–0. Decoding falls back when the average log probability is below this value.

no_speech_threshold.label: No-speech threshold
no_speech_threshold.hint: Range 0–1. Works with the log-probability threshold to skip no-speech segments; lower values skip more readily.

subtitleLength.label: Line breaking
subtitleLength.hintSmart: Splits lines at speech pauses and punctuation, keeping each subtitle at a readable length. Free and works out of the box.
subtitleLength.hintUnlimited: Split only at speech pauses and punctuation. Lines are never force-split by length and may run long.
subtitleLength.hintCustom: Lines over the limit are split at punctuation or word boundaries, never inside a word.
subtitleLength.hintAi: The AI breaks lines by meaning — numbers and fixed phrases are never cut by pauses. Requires an AI provider; falls back to standard segmentation on failure.

chinesePunctuation.label: Strip Chinese punctuation
chinesePunctuation.hint: Replace Chinese punctuation (，。、？！ etc.) in Chinese subtitles with spaces and trim trailing spaces for cleaner subtitles. Applies to the source when the source language is Chinese, and to the translation when the target is Chinese.

speakerDiarization.label: Speaker diarization
speakerDiarization.hint: After transcription and translation, analyze the full audio locally and align each cue with its speakers. Processing time scales with audio length; you can choose whether to write speaker labels into exported subtitle files.
speakerDiarization.modelMissingHint: You can save this setting, but the run will safely skip diarization. Make sure both the runtime and speaker diarization model are installed under Resources → Local multi-model engine.
speakerDiarization.speakerCountHint: Specifying a known count is usually more stable
speakerDiarization.embedInSubtitle: Write speaker labels to subtitle files
speakerDiarization.embedInSubtitleHint: When off, exported SRT/TXT and other subtitle files stay clean; speaker metadata is kept only in the app's proofread data.

provider.label: Refine provider
provider.followBlocked: Translation is off or not an AI provider — pick an AI provider explicitly.
provider.hint: Shared by AI segmentation and correction. Defaults to following the translation service; you can also pick a different one (e.g. a large model for translation, local Ollama for refining).

refine.approxNote: The current transcription engine has no word-level timestamps; AI segmentation will use an approximate timeline (proportional interpolation within each cue).

control.label: Line break & refine
control.title: Line break & refine
control.intro: Choose how lines break, and whether AI should polish the text. AI features fall back automatically on failure — never worse than off.
control.corrHint: Fix homophones and typos, remove fillers like "um / uh", normalize punctuation and casing — timing stays untouched.
control.maxCharsHint: CJK characters count as 2 (40 ≈ 20 Chinese characters), Latin counts per character. Over-long lines split safely at word boundaries.
